crossRefs.note: But Samuel ministered before Yahweh, being a child, clothed with a linen ephod.
Therefore I have also given him to Yahweh. As long as he lives he is given to Yahweh.” He worshiped Yahweh there.
The child Samuel ministered to Yahweh before Eli. Yahweh’s word was rare in those days. There were not many visions…
Samuel lay until the morning, and opened the doors of Yahweh’s house. Samuel was afraid to show Eli the vision.

people.name: Eli
people.line: High priest and judge of Israel at Shiloh

people.name: Elkanah
people.line: The father of the prophet Samuel.

people.name: Mizpah
people.line: A city in Benjamin; a place of gathering and judgment

translations.web: Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. The child served Yahweh before Eli the priest.
translations.bsb: Then Elkanah went home to Ramah, but the boy began ministering to the LORD before Eli the priest.
translations.kjv: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto the LORD before Eli the priest.
translations.asv: And Elkanah went to Ramah to his house. And the child did minister unto Jehovah before Eli the priest.
